batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2021-2022, Set-G — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.125-130 (printed book pp.124-129): questions on pp.125-128, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') and printed worked solutions for selected questions on pp.129-130. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. Printed structure (the paper itself prints no subject headings; blocks identified by content in printed order): Zoology 22 (Q1-22), IQ 4 (Q23-26), Chemistry 24 (Q27-50), English 4 (Q51-54), Botany 22 (Q55-76), Bangla 4 (Q77-80). Botany/Zoology are mapped to the canonical subject Biology with the split kept in topic, and Biology question numbering runs continuously in printed order (biology-01..22 = Zoology Q1-22; biology-23..44 = Botany Q55-76). Q41: the printed answer table shows a dash and the printed worked solution (p.129) states explicitly '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই); উত্তর হবে Gay-Lussac' — recorded as answerDisposition no_correct_option with correctOptionIds []; its answerVerificationStatus 'verified' records ONLY the book's own printed no-correct-option claim (validator convention), not independent verification. Q49 and Q50 share one printed stimulus (উদ্দীপক), which is included in both question texts so each is self-contained. Q26 depends on a printed 3x3 number grid (values reproduced in the text). Conventions: Bengali numerals converted to Western digits; chemical formulas flattened (CO2, H3O^+); superscripts linearised with ^; printed errors preserved and flagged in extractionNotes. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-G of JU D Unit 2021-2022 occupies book PDF pp.125-130 (printed book pp.124-129): questions pp.125-128, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.129 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions on pp.129-130 (01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 08, 10, 27, 29, 32, 38, 40, 41, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 51, 52, 53, 55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 60, 62, 63, 64, 65, 66, 67, 68, 69, 70, 73, 75, 76). Every printed worked solution was cross-checked against the answer table during transcription; all agree, including the Q41 no-correct-option statement. Transcription by direct visual reading of the page images, with 400-dpi zoom crops for doubtful glyphs; the page image was authoritative over any OCR draft.
